headline: Vikings TE T.J. Hockenson suffers concussion against Saints
summary: The Vikings' injury-ravaged offense absorbed another blow Sunday when tight end T.J. Hockenson suffered a concussion on the second play of their game against the Saints.

headline: Doctors fear risk of further Jayden Daniels elbow injury
summary: Doctors around the NFL believe it's a matter of when, not if, Commanders quarterback Jayden Daniels hurts his left elbow again, sources told ESPN.
